messages:
maria: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from this morning's outage. Need decisions on: status page wording, customer-facing RCA scope, and who owns remediation timelines. Please react with :eyes: if you can take ownership or drop a quick 👍/assign.
cheng: I can take statuspage wording. Ops wants to say 'partial degradation' but legal asked for measurable phrasing. I'll draft two variants.
alex (legal): Please include measurable impact where possible (e.g., % of requests, regions affected). For RCA sharing: we should share a customer summary + redacted technical RCA. Don't disclose internal credentials or PII.
sam: From SRE: short suggested statuspage text — feel free to reuse:
```
We experienced degraded inference throughput between 10:12–10:48 UTC impacting ~12% of requests routed to our eu-west region. Traffic normalized after target pool autoscaling and cache warmup.
```
Use 'degraded throughput' not 'complete outage' here.
nina: Support note: several enterprise customers already asked for an RCA and timeline. Proposed approach: public status update + offer gated customer-specific RCA (NDAs/secured link) for affected customers.
cheng: I'll own the public statuspage update. Owner: @cheng. Timeline: draft by EOD today, push change within 24h after signoff.
maria: Thanks — assigning remediation owners in the postmortem tracker now. Please confirm owners and firm deadlines so I can close actionables.
incident-bot: Action created: PM-453 — "Draft statuspage wording" assigned to cheng, due 2026-03-25.
alex (legal): I'll prepare a 1-page redaction checklist for RCA sharing (what to remove/what to keep) and send to @nina + @cheng by tomorrow morning.
sam: One more: recurring pattern note — cache warmup spikes after capacity changes keep showing up in the last 3 incidents. We should decide whether to call out a 'recurring issue' publicly or keep phrasing generic.
alex (legal): Recommend against saying 'recurring bug' publicly. Suggest: 'we are investigating a pattern related to cache and autoscaling behavior and will include mitigation steps in follow-up.'
nina: I'll draft the gated customer RCA template and the email text offering the private RCA. Will send to legal+cheng for signoff by Friday.
cheng: Also propose we add a short incident-pattern blurb to the monthly customer digest (ops-level only). Owner: @sam. Deliverable due next Monday.
sam: Got it — I'll compile incident-pattern notes and a 3-slide summary for the monthly digest.
maria: Recap (please confirm with emoji):
- Statuspage public wording: cheng — draft EOD, push within 24h
- Customer gated RCA + email: nina — draft by Fri
- Legal redaction checklist: alex (legal) — by tomorrow AM
- Incident patterns monthly digest: sam — slides by next Mon
- Postmortem action items updated in tracker: I'll assign deadlines now
Please confirm or update owners. If no reply, I'll assume confirmation and move items to 'in-progress'. :white_check_mark:
